scope: MacBook Pro Ubuntu hardware integration beyond graphics

cases.title: Apple multitouch trackpad missing or misclassified
evidence: Separate physical click failure from software tap/gesture configuration.
safe_direction: Do not install a third-party touchpad kernel driver before proving bcm5974 is absent or unsupported.

cases.title: Keyboard backlight unavailable or brightness keys ineffective
evidence: Check whether GNOME sees the relevant key events.
safe_direction: If a kbd_backlight LED endpoint exists, test through brightnessctl before adding daemons.
Do not install pommed merely because a key binding is missing.

cases.title: Broadcom Wi-Fi unavailable after installation
symptoms: Broadcom controller present but network unavailable
evidence: Capture exact Broadcom PCI ID and current driver from lspci -nnk.
Inspect rfkill, iw and current-boot kernel firmware/module errors.
Determine whether the existing path is wl/Broadcom STA or b43 before changing packages.
safe_direction: Keep both driver package families available in a full offline bundle.
Broadcom STA requires DKMS and matching kernel headers.
b43 offline repair requires a captured firmware/b43 payload; the installer package alone is not network-independent.
avoid: installing wl and b43 paths blindly
assuming all Broadcom PCI IDs use the same driver

cases.title: Bluetooth controller unavailable or blocked
evidence: Check btusb binding and rfkill state.
Check bluetooth.service and kernel firmware errors.
safe_direction: Use bluez-firmware only when logs/controller identity justify it.
Blueman is optional UI, not a driver fix.

cases.title: Apple function/media keys behave incorrectly
evidence: Inspect hid_apple parameters and actual input events.
Check GNOME media-key handling before installing another daemon.
safe_direction: Prefer kernel/module parameter or desktop configuration once the event path is understood.
Treat pommed as experimental legacy tooling, not a default package.

cases.title: High temperature or fan behavior concern
evidence: Collect lm-sensors output and applesmc/fan sysfs state.
Correlate temperature with CPU/GPU load and kernel throttling logs.
safe_direction: Do not install or enable multiple fan daemons.
mbpfan/macfanctld remain experimental until model-specific thermal validation is complete.

cases.title: Audio, camera or optical device missing
evidence: Use ALSA device enumeration for audio.
Use USB/video enumeration and v4l-utils for camera.
Use lsblk/udev and /dev/sr* for optical drive.
safe_direction: Separate kernel device detection from desktop/application routing.
Install diagnostic utilities before changing drivers.
